encounters.name: hawthorn tree
encounters.desc: A hawthorn tree stands before you, its branches heavy with sacred blossoms. The fae watch from the shadows, but allow respectful gathering.

encounters.name: mayflower patch
encounters.desc: A carpet of mayflowers blooms before your eyes, blessed by Beltane's magic and ripe for gathering.

encounters.name: fae blessing
encounters.desc: A fae spirit approaches, unbound by the loosened pacts. It bestows a blessing upon you for honoring the old ways.

encounters.name: beltane dancer
encounters.desc: A dancer moves around the Beltane fire, their movements weaving ribbons around the maypole and invoking ancient fertility magic.

encounters.name: ancient hawthorn
encounters.desc: An ancient hawthorn tree, guardian of the sacred grove. Its blossoms fall like snow, each petal carrying Beltane's blessing.

encounters.name: may meadow walk
encounters.desc: A peaceful walk through the May meadow, where hawthorn trees bloom and fae lights dance among the flowers.
encounters.flavor: The fae lights guide your path through the blooming meadow.

encounters.name: mayflower gathering
encounters.desc: You stumble across a thick patch of mayflowers, stems heavy with blooms. Easy pickings if you take the time to sort through them.
encounters.flavor: The best ones are always just a bit further in.

encounters.name: hawthorn blossom rain
encounters.desc: Hawthorn petals fall like rain from the hawthorn trees, creating a magical Beltane scene filled with protective magic.
encounters.flavor: The petals catch the light as they fall, each one a blessing.

encounters.name: the old growth stirs
encounters.desc: The Old Growth stirs among the trees, bark shifting like skin. It acknowledges your presence with a slow, creaking nod.
encounters.flavor: Something ancient has taken notice of you. Whether that is good remains to be seen.

encounters.name: sacred ground
encounters.desc: You discover ground blessed by the Beltane fires, exceptionally fertile and perfect for planting.
encounters.flavor: The earth itself seems to pulse with Beltane's magic.

encounters.name: hawthorn shade
encounters.desc: You rest beneath an ancient hawthorn tree, its blossoms falling like gentle snow. The fae watch peacefully from the shadows.
encounters.flavor: The tree's protective magic soothes your mind.

potions_unused.name: mayflower tea
potions_unused.desc: A fragrant tea brewed from mayflowers gathered on Beltane morning, filling you with vitality and protection from fae mischief.
potions_unused.needtext: Cannot be brewed out of season

potions_unused.name: fertility elixir
potions_unused.desc: A potent elixir blessed by the Beltane fires and the Old Growth's touch, enhancing growth and natural abilities.
potions_unused.needtext: Cannot be brewed out of season

upgrades_unused.name: withered grove
upgrades_unused.desc: The Beltane grove has withered with the passing of the season. The hawthorn trees stand dormant, their blossoms long faded, and the kell have withdrawn behind renewed pacts.
upgrades_unused.needtext: Can only be done during Beltane
